description:
Compile-time support for AgentSpaces annotations in Micronaut: maps the
    core method annotations (@SpaceTake, @SpaceNotify, @BidFunction, @Ballot,
    @OrderedTake, @OnDecision) to @Executable and @ReflectiveAccess, so a bean
    with only method annotations enrolls at startup and native images keep the
    reflection the binder needs. Goes on the annotation-processor path only.
